# Westfield Buzz

## About
Westfield Buzz (https://www.westfieldbuzz.com) is a local events guide for Westfield, New Jersey and nearby Union County towns including Summit, Cranford, Garwood, Rahway, Mountainside, and Fanwood. It aggregates public community events — concerts, festivals, markets, kids activities, sports, arts, and town programming — from municipal calendars and venue sites, deduplicates them across sources, and republishes one canonical listing per event.

Listings refresh automatically from source feeds. A free Friday email digest summarizes the coming week; readers can subscribe at https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/subscribe.

## Machine-readable access
- **Events API (JSON):** `GET https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/api/events` — published upcoming events, soonest first. Query params: `town`, `category`, `from` (YYYY-MM-DD), `to` (YYYY-MM-DD), `limit` (default 50, max 200). Example: `/api/events?town=Westfield&category=Music&limit=20`. Each event includes `isFree`, `costAmount`, `minAge`, `maxAge`, `registration`, and `environment` (null when the source did not list them). Cached at the edge; no key required. Full docs: https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/agents
- **OpenAPI spec:** https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/openapi.json describes the API, calendar feed, and feedback endpoint.
- **Calendar feed (iCalendar):** `https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/calendar.ics` — subscribable; takes the same filters as the API, e.g. `/calendar.ics?town=Cranford&category=Family%20%26%20Kids`.
- **Event pages:** every event has a stable URL at `https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/events/[id]` with schema.org Event JSON-LD (name, startDate, endDate, location, eventStatus, and offers / isAccessibleForFree / typicalAgeRange when listed).
- **Sitemap:** https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/sitemap.xml includes published event URLs.
- **Natural-language search:** https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/search accepts plain-English queries ("free kids events this weekend in Cranford").
- **Sources:** https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/sources lists every public calendar, venue, and organization the listings come from.

## Report problems
- **Feedback API:** `POST https://www.westfieldbuzz.com/api/feedback` with JSON `{"eventId": "<id from /api/events>", "reason": "wrong-details" | "cancelled" | "duplicate" | "not-local" | "other", "message": "..."}`. To suggest an event we don't list: `{"reason": "missing-event", "message": "name, date, link"}`. Returns 202; a person reads every report.

## Data notes
- Times are America/New_York.
- `eventStatus` follows schema.org: EventScheduled, EventCancelled, EventPostponed, EventRescheduled.
- Listings link back to the original source via `sourceUrl`; details can change, so the source is authoritative.
- Coverage is Westfield-first; nearby-town coverage depends on what local sources publish.
